title: Accessibility
description: Accessibility settings for STEEVEFAX: a plain text view, keyboard shortcuts and an old-TV screen effect, each with an on/off switch.
label: A11Y

rows.text: Use the switches below the screen.

rows: Shows every page as plain text, without the TV screen. The site remembers your choice.
Type a page number to go there. R, G, Y and B are the coloured buttons. H stops a page changing. Turn these off if you use voice control.
Adds the lines and glow of an old TV. It's off at first if your device asks for less motion or more contrast.
Zoom in any time to make text bigger.
